entities.summary: The Revolutionary Socialist Party (RSP) is a communist party in India. The party was founded on 19 March 1940 by Tridib Chaudhuri and has its roots in the Bengali liberation movement Anushilan Samiti and the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army. Revolutionary Socialist Party is a political party in Asia, established in 1938. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
